content.text:
Submitted.

**Changes made in this pass:**
1. **Section 13.2 (p0628)** — restated in plain permissive form: "Ono **may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time**, for any reasons, upon **thirty (30) days' prior written notice** … in which case **Array shall refund on a pro rata basis any prepaid fees or other amounts prepaid by Ono** for the period after the effective date of such termination." The delayed commencement tied to First Commercial Sale and the redacted notice period are deleted; the heading, "for any reasons" and the rationale-with-notice condition are retained verbatim. The refund noun now also picks up "other amounts prepaid" so it works with this licence's upfront/milestone economics, per the verifier's tightening note.
2. **Section 6.1 (p0384)** — I ran the diligence check the verifier asked for. The only retained non-refundability language is the upfront licence fee sentence, so I made the narrow conforming edit "Except as provided in Section 13.2, this license fee … shall not be refundable" rather than adding a broad notwithstanding override. The non-creditability wording and the rest of 6.1 are untouched.

**Element coverage (preferred):** convenience right, 30 days' notice, pro-rata refund — operations 1 (and 2 for the conflict cure); no Vendor convenience right — already met, since Article 13 read in full gives Array only for-cause exits (13.3, 13.4) and 13.5 runs to Ono alone.

Nothing else in Article 13, Article 14 wind-down, or Section 8.2 is disturbed.
